- Coordinate meetings, run sheets, and daily scheduling adjustments
- Monitor inbox and draft professional communications

- Track expenses, invoices, and financial documentation
- Support reconciliation and financial organisation

Travel & Logistics

- Manage changes across time zones and last-minute adjustments

Stakeholder Management

- Ensure clear, timely, and professional communication

Personal & Operational Support
- Support personal scheduling and family-related coordination
- Maintain visibility of recurring tasks and commitments

Systems & Efficiency
- Use AI and automation tools to improve workflows, productivity, and information management
- Identify repetitive or manual processes and recommend opportunities for automation
- Build, configure, or maintain practical AI-powered workflows and productivity systems
- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms for research, analysis, communication, and workflow optimisation
- Troubleshoot operational and systems-related problems and develop practical solutions
- Build and maintain simple systems that reduce recurring issues and operational friction
- Anticipate needs and proactively identify ways to improve how the principal works
- 5+ years' experience as a high-level EA / Executive Assistant
- Strong experience with Xero and financial administration
- Excellent written English and professional communication skills
- Proven ability managing multi-timezone calendars (AU/US/EU)
- High attention to detail and structured thinking
- Experience supporting senior executives or founders
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and productivity tools
- Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve business workflows and productivity
- Ability to independently research, assess, and implement practical technology solutions to operational problems
- Experience with automation platforms, integrations, AI agents, workflow tools, or systems optimisation is highly desirable
- Comfortable using AI tools to enhance efficiency
- Highly discreet, reliable, and proactive

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

- Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
- Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as "Independent Contractor")
